format: html

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
# install.packages("DiagrammeR")
library(DiagrammeR)

grViz("
digraph ggplot2 {
  graph [rankdir = LR]
  
  A[label='ggplot2\nVisual Guide']
  B[label='Grammar of\nGraphics']
  C[label='Basic\nStructure']
  D[label='Components']
  E[label='Faceting']
  F[label='Aesthetics']
  
  A -> B
  A -> C
  A -> D
  A -> E
  A -> F
  
  B -> label='position'
  B -> B2[label='color']
  B -> B3[label='size']
  B -> B4[label='shape']
  
  C -> C1[label='ggplot(data, aes())']
  C -> C2[label='geom_*()']
  C -> C3[label='layers (+)']
  
  D -> D1[label='Data']
  D -> D2[label='Aesthetics']
  D -> D3[label='Geoms']
  
  E -> E1[label='facet_wrap()']
  E -> E2[label='facet_grid()']
  
  F -> F1[label='x, y']
  F -> F2[label='color, fill']
  F -> F3[label='shape, size']
  F -> F4[label='alpha']
}
")
```
